about: Which Dawn of War model stands in for which simulator unit. See tools/dow/README.md. 'match' and 'not' are regular expressions tested against '<faction> <template> <vehicle> | <ranged weapon>|<melee weapon>|<armour>'; the first unit that matches is used. 'proxy' marks a stand-in for a unit the game has no model of.

units.match: Astra Militarum Sergeant|Inquisitorial Acolyte|Chaos Cultist Champion
